description: This file defines a class 'TimeValue' responsible for converting string representations of times into various Excel or PHP date/time formats. It provides methods to parse time strings, handle regex extraction, and generate corresponding date/time values in different formats.

classes.name: TimeValue
classes.description: A utility class for parsing time strings into Excel/PHP date/time values.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string or array of time representations into a corresponding Excel or PHP date/time value based on the current return type setting.
